comments.headline: No central dumpster or refuse facility shown
comments.summary: Site plan depicts only curbside collection with no central dumpster location, dimensions, or service area shown. This blocks verification of location compliance with parking and pedestrian area requirements, vehicle maneuvering containment, multi-building service allocation, and fire safety clearance.
comments.crossDep: Transportation (vehicle maneuvering verification); Fire Department (clearance assessment); Public Works/Solid Waste (if collection within ROW)
comments.attn: Multiple downstream compliance items depend on dumpster location being added to site plan first. Run 3 of 27.31 indicates Fire Department cover sheet note may also be missing or misplaced.

details.text: Site plan proposes only curbside collection with no central dumpster location identified with dimensions and maneuvering area. No alternative refuse collection facility is depicted.

runComments.comment: No dumpster or refuse collection facility location is shown on the site plan with required dimensions. Site plan currently proposes only curbside collection with no central trash facility identified. A central dumpster location with dimensions and maneuvering area must be shown to demonstrate that collection vehicle maneuvering is contained on-site without use of public right-of-way. The TPW-TDS reviewer comment (TPW 25) remains pending on this requirement.

Dumpster or refuse collection area location is not shown on site plan with required dimensions. Master Comment Report TPW-25 (Pending) indicates city requires identification of trash collection point and confirmation of collection method, but applicant response is pending. Site plan does not demonstrate collection vehicle maneuvering is contained on-site without using public ROW.

Site plan shows curbside trash collection note but does not identify or depict a dumpster/refuse collection area with dimensions, setback distances, or maneuvering area for collection vehicles on the site plan. No dumpster enclosure location, size, or collection vehicle turning radius is shown; therefore, compliance with TCM 9.4.1.C (location off main access/parking aisles away from pedestrian corridors) and TCM 9.4.1.D (maneuvering contained on-site without public ROW use) cannot be verified.

details.text: Trash pickup and delivery location cannot be verified as compliant with requirement to avoid intermixing with concurrent site operations and be located off main parking aisles and away from pedestrian corridors because no collection point is depicted.

runComments.comment: Trash pickup and delivery locations relative to parking drive aisles and pedestrian corridors cannot be verified because no central trash collection facility is shown on the site plan. Once a dumpster location is identified, verification that it is located off main access aisles and away from all pedestrian corridors will be required.

Trash pickup and delivery location not demonstrated to avoid intermixing with concurrent site operations. Site plan does not show collection point location, making verification impossible that trash collection facility is located off main access or parking aisles and away from all pedestrian corridors as required by TCM 9.4.1.C.

Site plan does not demonstrate that trash pickup and delivery will avoid intermixing with concurrent site operations. Without a shown or designated trash collection facility location, compliance with TCM 9.4.1.C requirement that trash collection be located off main access/parking aisles and away from pedestrian corridors cannot be verified.

details.text: Site plan does not clearly establish whether trash service is on-site, off-site, or shared with adjacent property. Curbside collection note does not clarify container storage location or service methodology.

runComments.comment: Site plan does not clearly establish whether trash service is on-site, off-site, or shared. Curbside collection note does not clarify trash container storage location or service methodology. No Unified Development Agreement, PDRD-accepted arrangement, or shared trash agreement is referenced or provided in the submittal.

details.text: Multi-building site (8 buildings, 39 units) does not clarify the number and location of dumpsters serving each building or establish that a single shared facility is adequate for all units.

runComments.comment: Multi-building site does not clarify the number and location of dumpsters serving each of the eight buildings. Site plan does not demonstrate whether multiple dumpsters are proposed or whether a single shared facility is adequate for all 39 units across all buildings. This allocation must be clearly shown on the site plan.

Multi-building site (8 buildings) does not clarify the number and location of dumpsters or trash containers serving each building. Plan does not demonstrate that a single shared facility (if that is the intent) is adequate for all buildings, nor does it establish per-building trash assignments.

details.text: Commercial dumpster fire safety clearance (minimum 10 feet from building openings, combustible walls, and eaves) cannot be verified because no dumpster location, dimensions, or measured distances to building elements are depicted on site plan.
details.citation: General Site Plan Notes (Fire Department section)

runComments.comment: Commercial dumpster 10-foot fire safety clearance cannot be verified because no dumpster is shown on the site plan with location and dimensions. While the Fire Department note is present on Sheet 3 (correctly stating the 10-foot clearance requirement), compliance cannot be assessed without a depicted dumpster location and measured distances to building openings and combustible elements.

Compliance with Fire Department note requiring commercial dumpster or container ≥1.5 CY clearance cannot be verified. No dumpster location is shown on site plan, and confirmation that the required Fire Department standard note is included in plan notes is not evident.

The required Fire Department note regarding commercial dumpsters and containers is missing from the site plan cover sheet. The note 'Commercial dumpsters and containers ≥ 1.5 cubic yards shall not be stored within 10 feet of openings, combustible walls, or combustible eave lines' is required in the Fire Department section of all Austin site plans.

details.text: Garbage collection vehicle maneuvering cannot be demonstrated as fully contained on-site because no central trash facility location, turning radius, or maneuvering area is labeled or identified on the site plan.

runComments.comment: Garbage collection vehicle maneuvering cannot be verified as fully contained on-site because no dumpster facility is shown on the site plan. No turning radius or maneuvering area is depicted. A central trash facility location with sufficient on-site turning area for collection vehicles must be shown on the site plan to verify compliance.

Garbage collection vehicle maneuvering containment on-site cannot be verified. Site plan does not show collection point location, and Master Comment Report TPW-25 remains pending regarding collection methodology. TPW-27 also remains pending receipt of trash service commitment letter confirming minimum clearance and maneuverability requirements.

No specific maneuvering area for garbage collection vehicles is labeled or identified on the site plan. Without a designated dumpster location or marked collection vehicle turning radius and maneuvering area, compliance with TCM 9.4.1.D (maneuvering fully contained on-site without use of public ROW) cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Missing dumpster design, setback, and cover sheet documentation
comments.summary: Once dumpster location is depicted, site plan must demonstrate: enclosure dimensions accommodating both trash and recycling containers, 20-foot setback from adjacent SF-3 property with required cover sheet note, Article 10 Compatibility 15-foot setback with concrete slab, and screening preventing visibility from shared property line.
comments.applicableArea: Site Interior; Dumpster Location Relative to SF-3 Adjacent Property
comments.crossDep: Fire Department (final location approval when sited)
comments.attn: All detailed compliance items (27.8, 27.15, 27.19, 27.25) are conditional on dumpster location being shown in Comment 1. Enclosure sizing (27.8) requires comparison of trash and recycling container volumes against proposed enclosure dimensions. Setback issues involve two distinct regulatory standards (general site plan notes vs. Article 10 Compatibility).

details.text: Dumpster or trash enclosure dimensions are not shown or dimensioned on site plan. Both trash and recycling containers must fit simultaneously within the screened dumpster pad; enclosure adequacy cannot be verified without dimensions.

runComments.comment: Dumpster enclosure sizing cannot be verified because no dumpster facility is shown on the site plan. Once a dumpster location and enclosure are identified, dimensions must confirm that both trash and recycling containers fit simultaneously within the screened dumpster pad.

Dumpster enclosure adequacy cannot be verified. Site plan does not show enclosure dimensions or demonstrate that both trash and recycling containers can fit simultaneously within the screened dumpster pad. Master Comment Report TPW-26 indicates roll-out bins may be proposed rather than a fixed dumpster, but the plan does not clarify which method is being used or provide dimensions.

details.text: Dumpster 20-foot setback from adjacent SF-3 residential property is not shown with measured distance on site plan. Additionally, the required Compatibility section cover sheet note stating 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive' is missing.
details.citation: General Site Plan Notes (Compatibility section); LDC § 25-3-86(D)

runComments.comment: Dumpster location and setback from SF-5 or more restrictive adjacent properties cannot be verified because no dumpster is shown on the site plan with distance measurements. The site is adjacent to an SF-3 parcel (which is SF-5 or more restrictive per the grouping definition). Once a dumpster location is identified, a minimum 20-foot setback from this property line must be demonstrated.

Compliance with 20-foot setback for dumpster or permanently placed refuse receptacle from adjacent SF-3 residential property cannot be verified because no dumpster or refuse receptacle location is shown on site plan. No setback dimensions are provided.

Site is adjacent to SF-3 property (triggering property per Article 10 Compatibility Standards). No dumpster or permanently placed refuse receptacle is shown on the site plan; therefore, the minimum 20-foot setback distance from the SF-3 property cannot be measured or verified.

details.text: Site plan cover sheet is missing the standard Compatibility section note: 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive.' This is a standard requirement for all Austin site plans.

runComments.comment: The required Compatibility section note is not present on the cover sheet. The standard note 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive' must be included in the site plan cover sheet Compatibility notes section. This is a standard requirement for all Austin site plans regardless of whether a Compatibility Standards provision is triggered.

Site plan does not include the required Compatibility section note: 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive.' This note is a standard Austin site plan submittal requirement per General Site Plan Notes (Compatibility section).

The required Compatibility section note is missing from the site plan cover sheet. Standard Austin site plans must include the note: 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive.' This note is required on all sites as part of standard submittal requirements.

details.text: Site is subject to Article 10 Compatibility Standards (MF-2 zoning adjacent to SF-3 property). No refuse receptacle location or concrete slab is depicted on site plan; therefore, the required 15-foot setback from triggering property cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Site is subject to Article 10 Compatibility Standards (MF-2 zoning adjacent to SF-3 triggering property within 75 feet). No concrete slab for a refuse receptacle is depicted on the site plan; therefore, compliance with the 15-foot setback requirement from the triggering property cannot be verified.

details.text: Site is adjacent to SF-3 residential property. Refuse collection area screening to prevent visibility at shared property line (Article 10 requirement) and general service area screening cannot be verified because no refuse collection facility is depicted on site plan.

runComments.comment: Refuse collection area screening from adjacent residential properties cannot be verified because no central trash collection facility is shown on the site plan. The site is adjacent to residential properties (SF-3 parcel), which require screening per LDC § 25-2-1006(C). Once a dumpster location is identified, dimensions from the facility to the nearest residential property and screening details must be shown.

Refuse collection area screening from adjacent residential properties cannot be verified because no trash collection area is depicted on site plan. Dimensions from trash facility to nearest residential property are not shown, making screening compliance unverifiable.

Site is adjacent to SF-3 residential property. No refuse collection area is depicted on the site plan; therefore, compliance with screening requirements to prevent visibility at the shared property line (Article 10, LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(4)) and general service area screening (LDC § 25-2-1006(C)) cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Recycling ordinance compliance missing plan form and facilities
comments.summary: Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance requires completion and submission of Recycling Plan Form to Solid Waste Services, on-site recycling container storage area with dimensions, and recycling equipment location clearly identified on site plan. None of these are currently provided or documented.
comments.crossDep: Solid Waste Services Department (Recycling Plan Form review and acceptance)
comments.attn: Recycling Plan Form must be completed by property owner prior to approval per Austin City Code § 15-6. Submission to Solid Waste Services within 14 days after building occupancy is a post-occupancy requirement. Recycling storage and equipment locations must be dimensioned and clearly labeled on site plan.

details.text: Completed Multi-Family Recycling Plan Form required by Austin City Code § 15-6 is not present in submittal documents. Evidence of submission to Solid Waste Services Department is not provided; form must be completed by property owner.

runComments.comment: Multi-Family Recycling Plan Form (required by Austin City Code § 15-6) completion and submittal status cannot be verified. No completed form or evidence of submission to Solid Waste Services Department is present in the site plan submittal or supplementary documents.

Multi-Family Recycling Plan Form completion and submission status cannot be verified. No completed form is present in available submittals. Sheet 1 includes mandatory note that compliance with Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance is required, but evidence of property owner completing and submitting the form to Solid Waste Services is not provided.

Multi-Family Recycling Plan Form required by Austin City Code Chapter 15-6 is not completed, submitted, or referenced in the site plan set. While the cover sheet notes that compliance with the Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance is mandatory, no completed form documentation is provided.

details.text: No evidence of submission of completed Recycling Plan Form to Solid Waste Services within 14 days after building occupancy is available. Occupancy has not yet occurred; however, form must be completed and approved prior to site plan approval.

runComments.comment: Recycling Plan Form submission status cannot be verified. The requirement to submit the form to Solid Waste Services within 14 days after buildings are occupied is a post-occupancy requirement; however, the form must be completed prior to approval and available for inspection.
Recycling Plan Form submission to Solid Waste Services within 14 days after occupancy cannot be verified. No evidence of submission exists in available records, and occupancy has not yet occurred.

details.text: No designated on-site recycling container storage area with dimensions is depicted on site plan. For 39-unit multi-family development, space must be provided and clearly labeled for storage of recycling receptacles and collection containers as required by City recycling ordinance.

runComments.comment: Space for storage of recycling containers is not shown or identified on the site plan. A designated on-site recycling storage area must be provided and depicted with dimensions on the site plan.

On-site storage space for recycling containers is not shown on site plan. No designated recycling storage area is labeled or depicted on the site plan drawings, making compliance verification impossible.

No designated on-site storage area for recycling containers is shown on the site plan. For a 39-unit multi-family development, space must be provided for storage of recycling receptacles and collection containers as required by the City's recycling ordinance.

details.text: Recycling equipment location is not shown or labeled on site plan. For multi-family development, if recycling facilities are located outside the building, their location must be clearly identified with dimensions on the site plan.

runComments.comment: Recycling equipment location is not shown on the site plan. For a 39-unit multi-family project, recycling facilities are required outside the building by Austin City Code § 15-6, and their location must be depicted on the site plan.

Recycling equipment location is not shown on site plan when recycling facilities are required outside the building. No exterior recycling storage area or equipment location is depicted or labeled on the site plan.

Recycling equipment location is not shown on the site plan. For a multi-family development, if recycling facilities are located outside the building (which appears to be the case), their location must be clearly identified on the site plan.
